categories.main_business_segments: MayAir Technology (China) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the air purification industry, focusing on industrial-grade ultra-clean technology for semiconductor cleanrooms, biopharmaceutical cleanrooms, public health safety, commercial indoor air quality, and atmospheric emission control. Its main products include fan filter units (FFU), various filters (primary, medium, high-efficiency, electrostatic, chemical), air purification equipment, industrial dust and oil mist removal devices, and VOCs treatment equipment. The company also provides integrated cleanroom solutions and system integration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as high-efficiency and ultra-high-efficiency filtration, FFU energy-saving and noise reduction, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation, high-voltage electrostatic adsorption, medium filtration, 'electric bag integration' technology, activated carbon adsorption, ion exchange fiber technology, impregnation-type fiber modification, catalytic oxidation decomposition, and biological medical air purification technologies. Production is order-driven with multiple domestic and overseas manufacturing bases, employing advanced automated production lines and strict quality control systems certified by ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, and CNAS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor manufacturers, biopharmaceutical companies, public health institutions, and commercial real estate sectors such as hospitals, shopping malls, high-end office buildings, and residential homes. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying major semiconductor fabs and other high-tech industries requiring stringent air cleanliness standards. The semiconductor cleanroom segment accounts for the largest revenue share.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with nine domestic production bases and two overseas manufacturing facilities in Malaysia and Canada. It has sales and investment subsidiaries in Singapore, Thailand, Japan, the UK, the US, and Hong Kong, actively expanding in Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, and the Middle East. Overseas revenue reached approximately RMB 228 million in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: MayAir operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the air purification supply chain, producing core cleanroom equipment and consumables such as FFUs and filters. It also extends upstream by developing proprietary filtration materials and downstream by providing integrated cleanroom solutions and after-sales services, including consumable replacements and system integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in new filtration materials (e.g., PTFE membranes, nanofibers, activated carbon modification), environmental emission control technologies (VOCs treatment, dust and oil mist removal), biological medical air purification, and digital air quality monitoring. It emphasizes energy efficiency, noise reduction, and system integration, supported by 31 specialized laboratories and over 450 testing instruments. The company also focuses on overseas market expansion, especially in Southeast Asia, and aims to enhance its full lifecycle traceability and digital air purification solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of air purification products and systems, including fan filter units, filters, and environmental control equipment. The company also earns recurring revenue from consumable replacements (filters) and provides integrated solutions and after-sales services. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales to end customers and some distribution channels, with large projects often secured through bidding.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in semiconductor cleanroom air purification equipment, competing with international brands such as AAF and Camfil. It holds a leading position in China’s semiconductor cleanroom equipment market and is recognized for its core technologies and product quality that can compete with global benchmarks. The industry is fragmented but increasingly consolidating, with a trend towards integrated cleanroom solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.723 billion, a 14.45% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 192 million, up 10.83%. Total assets reached RMB 3.699 billion, growing 23.68%, with net assets of RMB 1.792 billion, up 9.73%. R&D expenses accounted for 4.52% of revenue. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding domestic and international markets and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MayAir emphasizes its comprehensive cleanroom air purification solutions with advanced filtration technologies that achieve ultra-high filtration efficiency (up to 99.999997% for 0.1-micron particles) and energy-saving performance. Its products feature low resistance, low noise, and long service life, supported by proprietary material modification technologies. The company offers full lifecycle traceability, digital monitoring, and customized solutions tailored to stringent semiconductor and biopharmaceutical cleanroom requirements, differentiating itself through innovation, quality certifications, and global customer trust.
